text: The spectrum is large, but is also very very crowded. As mentioned at the beginning, mobile communications, mobile services, are expanding more and more, and so there are many different technologies that need to use the wireless spectrum. And the wireless spectrum, where we can transmit, is not infinite. Okay, so we have finite resources, and these resources are on high demand, so they are becoming precious. So transmitting at lower frequencies, like at megahertz or or gigahertz, is advantages from the point of view of ability of the signal to propagate from the transmitter to the receiver. Why? Because if the frequency is low, then the wavelength is longer, and our signals can travel farther away, maintaining a good level of power. So they are less affected by the attenuation that the signal experiences while traveling from the transmitter to the receiver. You may remember, let me just temporarily go ahead a bit. You may remember.
